title: 法案排上九月表决，ETF流入11亿美元：BTC为何没涨？
subTitle:
美国加密监管迎来实质性推进：参议院多数党领袖已为《CLARITY Act》安排休会后的关键程序性表决。但这不是“法案已经通过”，更不是监管利好落地。BTC在约6.48万美元附近仅涨0.2%，市场正在等待的，是能否真正凑够60票。

这次变化比普通口头承诺更进一步。Reuters报道，参议院多数党领袖John Thune已提交程序，为9月中旬复会后举行关键表决铺路，之后才可能进入全院投票。若要跨过程序门槛，法案需要60票，现阶段至少要争取8名民主党议员支持。换句话说，法案从“被搁置”变成“排上日程”，但最难的跨党派谈判仍未完成。

资金面也出现了有趣的背离。按Farside数据计算，8月3日至7日美国现货BTC ETF连续五个交易日净流入，合计约8.65亿美元；ETH ETF同期净流入约2.44亿美元，两者合计约11.09亿美元。然而CoinGecko显示，BTC下午约6.48万美元、24小时仅涨0.2%，ETH约1917美元、几乎持平。ETF买盘托住了下方，却没有触发追价，说明市场仍有存量卖盘，也不愿在周末为尚未确定的法案支付过高溢价。

为什么《CLARITY Act》重要？它试图界定数字资产何时属于证券或商品，并划分SEC与CFTC的监管边界。如果通过，交易所、代币发行方和机构资金面对的规则成本会更可预测，长期有助于降低行业风险折价。对BTC、ETH等成熟资产是制度性利多，对合规交易平台、托管和代币化业务同样重要。

但阻力也很清楚。多名民主党参议员要求加强官员利益冲突、消费者保护、反洗钱和市场诚信条款；银行业则担心稳定币奖励可能分流存款。任何一项谈判破裂，都可能让9月的程序表决再次延后。美国中期选举临近，也意味着立法窗口正在收窄。

接下来重点看四点：是否有至少8名民主党议员公开支持；最终文本对稳定币奖励、DeFi和官员持币如何处理；BTC能否在美股开盘后放量站稳6.5万美元；以及ETF流入能否延续，而不是周一突然反转。

风险提示：程序性推进不等于法案通过，周末流动性较薄，价格可能在美盘恢复后重新定价。本文不构成投资建议，不宜仅凭单条政策标题追涨。

俄军突袭哈尔科夫无人机库！避险情绪升温BTC $64,867稳了吗

💡 利多看涨。地缘冲突升级直接触发避险资金涌入加密资产。

BTC当前$64,867.1，24h仅微跌0.19%，这种跌幅在战争新闻面前基本等于没跌。

说实话，看到这条新闻我第一反应是去看了眼盘面。俄军直接炸了哈尔科夫的无人机库，说白了这是军事行动进一步升级的信号。每次这种地缘冲突消息出来，传统市场先慌，资金本能往硬资产跑。

ETH报$1,917.92，24h甚至微涨0.03%，说明市场对这个级别的消息已经有一定免疫力了。

怎么回事

俄军这次精准打击了哈尔科夫的无人机仓库。哈尔科夫是离俄罗斯边境最近的乌克兰大城市，一直是双方拉锯的核心区域。打无人机库不是随便炸的，这是直接掐乌克兰的反击能力。

说白了就是俄方在展示肌肉，告诉市场"别以为和平谈判快来了"。这消息一出，黄金和原油大概率短线上冲，加密这边反应相对克制。Crypto Briefing的原文提到这会影响市场对乌克兰领土恢复能力的信心，讲真这个判断没错，地缘风险溢价会上去。

对市场的影响

短期来看，冲突升级的消息历史上对BTC是双刃剑，但2024年的规律很清楚——恐慌情绪初期可能砸一下，但资金很快会认识到加密是"可携带的避险资产"。BTC在$64,867的位置挂了0.19%的跌幅，这个波动率说明卖盘已经枯竭了。

【The ETH ecosystem is brewing a silent split】

Over the past week, the price action around $ 1914 has ground on for a full seven days.

Honestly, I’ve seen this kind of choppy consolidation too many times—not because the market has no direction, but because the direction is waiting for a trigger point. And that trigger point is arriving sooner than I expected.

Within 48 hours, two things happen at the same time: the EIP-8363 proposal attempts to reduce the amount of staked issuance, and weETH is instead cleanly separated out from the restaking system. Viewed separately, both are technical adjustments. But put together, the logic is crystal clear—there is a fundamental disagreement within the Ethereum ecosystem over how staking rewards should be allocated.

Supporters say: reduce issuance; tokens become scarcer; long-term benefits follow.

Opponents say: you’ve touched DeFi’s cheese—decentralization and institutional adoption will both be affected.

From my experience, internal arguments like this are, on the surface, about technology, but in reality, they’re about how profits are distributed. ETH staking rewards were originally around 5% annualized; they’ve since been pushed to even higher levels through restaking. The cake is only so big—if someone takes an extra slice, others must take less.

So what does this translate to in practice?

If you’re running DeFi strategies on ETH, you’ll need to reassess how reliable your sources of yield are going forward. If you hold weETH or other restaking derivatives, you must see clearly whether you’re exposed to “plain staking” or “high-risk restaking”—these two things have already been clearly separated by the market.

One more point that’s easy to overlook: institutions fear uncertainty the most. With the in-fighting happening like this, the regular forces may actually become more cautious when they step in.

From a business-logic perspective, for Ethereum to move forward, it must find a balance between “the inflation rate” and “ecosystem vitality.” But it looks like this balance hasn’t been found yet.

My view is that, in the short term, the 1860–1960 range will continue to grind. The real decision on direction may have to wait until the outcome of this proposal’s debate. The sentiment index is still in the Fear zone at 31, which suggests the market isn’t hopeless—but it also definitely isn’t confident.

What about you? Do you think EIP-8363 will actually get implemented in the end? Or will it just turn into another proposal that goes nowhere?

That's where infrastructure starts to matter.

I've been paying more attention to @stonfi  for this reason. It's not just the swap itself it's the liquidity and execution layer underneath it.

I also think about the potential downstream effect:
More capital → more on-chain activity → more demand for liquidity → more need for efficient swaps and cross-chain execution.
Of course, $49.6M of ETF inflows isn't going to suddenly transform DeFi overnight.

But if institutional and retail capital continues moving into crypto, the infrastructure connecting that capital to different opportunities becomes increasingly important.

That's the part of the market I'm watching beyond the charts.

title: BTC卡在6.5万美元，ETH却开始抢镜：市场真的在切换主线吗？
subTitle:
很多人还在等BTC突破，市场里的另一个变化却已经先出现：BTC在关键位置反复受阻时，ETH正在悄悄拿回一部分注意力。

据8月8日公开行情报道，BTC一度运行在64,966美元附近，6.5万美元上方依然存在明显压力；同期ETH约为1,915美元，短线动能相对更强。CoinGecko近期数据显示，ETH/BTC汇率约在0.0295附近。这个数字不算高，却透露出一个值得观察的信号——市场可能正从“只看BTC”转向重新评估ETH。

先把结论说在前面：这还不能叫作主线反转，更不能简单理解为“山寨季来了”。周末流动性通常偏薄，少量资金就可能放大相对涨幅；BTC只要重新放量突破，资金仍可能迅速回到它身上。

但ETH为什么会在这个时间点更受关注？

第一，低位预期差。ETH今年的相对表现长期落后BTC，ETH/BTC汇率曾在低位徘徊。当一个资产被持续低估、市场仓位又相对拥挤在另一边时，只要出现边际改善，就容易触发补涨讨论。注意，补涨是资金行为，不代表基本面已经完成反转。

第二，市场在交易“可使用的链上经济”。BTC更接近宏观资产叙事，而ETH承载稳定币、DeFi、RWA和大量智能合约活动。当监管讨论从“能不能存在”逐步转向“如何合规运行”，具备应用基础设施属性的网络会重新进入机构观察名单。

第三，升级预期重新进入视野。市场近期开始关注以太坊后续扩容与执行效率改进。但升级预期只是催化剂，真正决定价值的仍是链上活跃度、费用收入、稳定币结算规模以及开发者是否持续留下。

判断这次变化是不是“真轮动”，不要只盯ETH美元价格，可以看三个信号：

一是ETH/BTC汇率能否连续走高，而不是单日脉冲；二是ETH上涨时现货成交是否同步放大，而非主要由高杠杆合约推动；三是资金是否只集中在ETH，还是开始扩散到优质基础设施与应用赛道。

如果只有价格上涨，没有成交、链上活动和资金扩散配合，那更像短线反弹；如果三项同时改善，才可能意味着市场风险偏好正在发生结构性变化。

当前最容易犯的错误，是看到ETH相对强势就追逐所有小市值代币。历史上，资金轮动通常有层级：BTC稳定，ETH走强，主流赛道得到确认，最后才可能扩散。任何一层中断，后面的高波动资产都可能迅速回撤。

所以眼下真正值得讨论的，不是“ETH能涨到哪里”，而是市场是否开始从单一避险叙事，重新为链上应用定价。

你认为这只是周末的短线补涨，还是ETH正在重新夺回市场主线？

风险提示：数字资产波动较大，短期相对强势不代表趋势确认。本文仅作市场信息与行业观察，不构成投资建议。

ETH is currently around 1915, having hovered right below the 7-day high of 1943 for several days.

The price action looks strong—it's sitting near the highs, and the moving averages are also above the 10-day and 50-day lines. Sentiment is leaning toward the bulls: spot ETF flows have been net inflows for five consecutive weeks, and institutions are still adding positions.

But the real issue is that actual buy-side money hasn't followed through.

In the past 3 hours, spot large orders have been net outflows, and none of the 12 funding candles turned positive. On the derivatives side, taker sells are actually higher than buys. The price pushed up to 1925 and again to 1943 twice, but it couldn't break through either time. Volume is still less than half of the average volume—this rally looks more like exhaustion than a breakout.

What’s even more important is that leverage is being built up. Over the last 12 hours, the loan ratio has jumped significantly, and open interest has been rising too—yet the price hasn't made new highs. The higher you stack leverage in a high zone, the more it will accumulate; once the funding can’t keep up, volatility will only expand, not contract.

To put it simply: right now it's a situation where the story is strong but the money hasn't arrived. The ETF and sentiment give bulls confidence, but spot large orders are pulling back and there’s no volume behind the breakout—these two sides are fighting each other.

So I won’t chase from this level. I'll wait for two kinds of signals: either a breakout with volume that eats through 1943 and confirms the trend, or a pullback to see whether there are buyers stepping in. Until then, let the market choose the direction on its own.

The news flow is all good. ETFs have seen net inflows for five straight weeks; BlackRock swept in more than 200 million that week again; institutions are talking about adding positions; the whales’ allocation is still bullish at 60%; and on the plaza everyone is shouting louder than the last.

But if you watch the money, everything looks different. In the spot market, over a three-hour window there isn’t even a single green candle out of the 12 bars—everything is being pulled out. As for big orders, it’s still net outflow.

They shout “ETF” while actual cash is running out in real terms. The price just can’t hold up—it keeps grinding here day after day.

It’s even clearer on the futures side: passive sell orders are pressing down against buy orders on one side—the sell volume is more than three times the buy volume. The funding rate is still positive, but those few cents of interest can’t support the chart.

The batch that borrowed to pump has cut away 99% again within 12 hours. Last time they came in after a surge by dozens of times; this time they’re completely wiped out. I just don’t understand what they were busy doing for all that time.

Trading volume is also less than half the average. No volume, no breakout—so it’s only the news propping things up. It can’t rally properly, and it can’t dump cleanly either. At a position like this, it’s exactly what I fear most.

So I’m not in a rush to chase here. Chasing longs has genuinely poor cost-effectiveness. I’ll wait for this ETF halo to fade, and let the market decide the direction on its own—don’t go “top up against the wall” to catch it.

说白了就是灰度研究主管Zach Pandl给市场交了底：就算今年旨在建立美国加密市场完整框架的CLARITY法案没法通过，行业照样能往前走。他的核心逻辑非常清晰——加密货币在没有全面监管的情况下已经活了17年。即便国会不立法，SEC等监管机构完全可以通过常规的规则制定来填补空白，比如代币化证券的监管。至于对BTC的需求、稳定币支付以及主流区块链的运作，这法案没过也不会产生什么立竿见影的负面冲击。灰度这波表态，就是告诉市场不要把鸡蛋全放在一个法案篮子里。

我的判断
讲真，灰度这话是典型的稳军心。这事儿定性为中性偏利好，给空头泼了盆冷水，所谓“法案不通过就是大崩盘”的纯利空逻辑直接被证伪。只要SEC的规则制定不搞突然袭击，大环境依然是震荡筑底。我维持BTC在$65,055附近企稳的判断，短线继续看反弹，老铁们别被小道消息洗下车。

For key price levels: 1,919.54 is the current structural midline and the first benchmark for judging whether a pullback is healthy. For those who already have positions, the focus is to manage based on whether supports fail, rather than being dragged along by every fluctuation. For those with no positions, prioritize waiting for a breakout-and-retest or confirmation of support. For spot, position can be built in batches; for futures, shorten the decision chain: first set the stop-loss level, then decide whether to participate.

Risk control remains before any conclusions: only act when conditions appear; if the price action invalidates the thesis, reevaluate promptly. According to recent insights from the International Monetary Fund (IMF), an interesting paradox is emerging in the crypto space.
Many emerging economies and domestic markets have been exploring local-currency stablecoins to reduce their financial reliance on dollar-backed tokens. However, top IMF officials point out a major twist: They might actually accelerate the shift toward digital dollars instead!
🔍 Why Is This Happening?
Shared Infrastructure: Once local stablecoins and dollar-backed giants operate on the same blockchain rails, users don’t need traditional banks to swap currencies.
Seamless Swaps: Through decentralized exchanges (DEXs), liquidity pools, and P2P networks, users can instantly trade their local tokens for digital dollars.
Liquidity & Trust: Due to higher global liquidity, network effects, and wide acceptance across international platforms, users naturally lean toward USD-pegged assets during economic friction.
📉 What Does This Mean for Crypto & Global Finance?
As blockchain technology bypasses traditional foreign exchange (FX) dealers and banks, capital flow monitoring is becoming harder for local authorities. While this creates smooth cross-border payment rails and financial freedom for everyday users, it poses serious questions about currency substitution and monetary control for developing nations.

ETH is currently around 1916. I’m leaning toward observing for now and not rushing to take action.

First, the conclusion: the news flow is genuinely lively—ETFs have seen consecutive net inflows, and BlackRock bought more than $200 million worth of ETH again this week. Meanwhile, KOL sentiment scores are also staying strong on the bullish side. But the price itself hasn’t reacted much. It’s been consolidating for more than a full day: both the 4-hour and 1-hour charts are mostly sideways. This isn’t a lack of positives—it’s that the positives weren’t taken up.

The issue is the direction of the money. On the spot side, large orders have been net outflow for the past few hours: not a single one of the 12 candles is green. This indicates that big capital talks bullish, but is actively withdrawing. At the same time, leverage on the derivatives side is rising: the borrow rate jumped more than 20% in 12 hours, and spot leverage long/short ratio has pushed above 7, leaving the long positions pretty crowded. This combination is a bit contradictory—sentiment and leverage are both high, yet the spot funds are moving out.

Also, selling pressure on the order book isn’t light either. The buy side is thin, and passive buying/active execution is more skewed toward selling. Trading volume is still less than half of the average volume. On the technical side, ADX is below 20—this is basically a ranging market, so indicators have limited value for reading trend.

In plain terms: both bulls and bears have reasons. But neither side has been able to push through the other. Positives are there and the structure leans bullish, but spot absorption isn’t sufficient, and leverage is crowded. Chasing longs from this area is generally not great in terms of risk-reward—if you rush in, you can get hit from both sides.

My approach is to wait. Either wait for volume to expand and spot net inflows to turn positive before considering a pullback entry, or wait for this leverage situation to get cleared first, with price stabilizing again before going in. Right now, I’m standing in the middle—watch which side the funds choose first.

#eth $ETH

content:
ETH 现在 1916 附近，这个位置我偏观望，不急着动手。

先说结论：消息面确实热闹，ETF 连续净流入、BlackRock 这周又扫了 2 亿多美金的 ETH，KOL 情绪分也顶在强多区。但价格本身没啥反应，盘了整整一天多，4 小时、1 小时全是横盘，这不是没利好，是利好没接住。

问题出在钱的方向上。现货这边大单近几小时一直在净流出，12 根柱一根正的都没有，说明大资金嘴上喊多、手上在撤。同时合约端杠杆在加：借贷比 12 小时跳了 20% 多，现货杠杆多空比拉到 7 以上，多头仓位挤得挺满。这组合有点拧巴——情绪和杠杆都在上，现货钱却在走。

另外盘口卖压也不算轻，买盘薄、主动吃单偏向卖，成交量还不到均量的一半。技术面 ADX 在 20 以下，就是个震荡市，指标对趋势的参考意义有限。

说白了，现在多空都有理由，但谁都没把对方打穿。利好在、结构偏多，可现货承接不足、杠杆又拥挤，这种位置追多的性价比一般，冲进去容易两头挨打。

我的做法是等。要么等成交放量、现货净流入转正，再考虑回踩接；要么等这波杠杆先清理一下，价格回稳再进。现在站中间，看资金先选哪边。

比特币最大的特点之一，就是稀缺性。BTC 总量上限只有 2100 万枚，数量不会无限增加。随着时间推移，如果市场需求持续增长，而可流通的 BTC 越来越稀缺，它的长期价值可能会更加受到关注。

当 BTC 出现强势上涨时，市场信心往往也会随之增强，资金可能逐渐流向 ETH、BNB、SOL 等其他加密资产，从而带动整个 Crypto 市场的活跃度。

我的想法很简单：
不要因为 FOMO 追高，也不要把全部资金一次性投入。

周日晚这块盘子，ETH 跟 BTC 一个德行——没脾气。现价 1917，24h 微跌一毛（-0.10%），日内高低 1925.85 / 1911.10，振幅不到 0.8%，整晚就在 1910 到 1926 这十来刀的缝里蹭。成交量 17.33 亿 USDT，跟前两天差不多，还是那个缩量局：没人愿意出真金白银选方向，多空都懒得动。从 8 月初那波 1776 低点拉起来后，ETH 已经在 1900 一带横了快一周，这种窄幅磨法是变盘前夜的典型姿态，但今晚看不出哪边先动手。

📊 技术面
三个周期拆开，节奏是「小时中性偏强、4h 刚转多、日线还在修复坑里」。1h 图最无聊也最稳：价格 1917 贴着 MA7(1918)、MA25(1918)、MA50(1917) 三道黏在一起，三线几乎重合在 1917，RSI14 52.7 卡在中性正中，MACD 柱状 0.11 翻了小红柱但动能极弱——这就是教科书级别的平衡态，短线没方向，谁先放量谁说了算。4h 才有看头：价格站上 MA7(1918)、MA25(1911)、MA50(1887) 三道，RSI14 65.4 接近偏强区，均线开始拧成多头排列雏形，MACD 柱状 -1.09 虽还是绿但快慢线都在水上，这周期是「脱离下沿后往区间上沿推的确认段」，比小时图硬。日线最关键也最弱：MA7(1898)、MA25(1891) 都踩在脚下，但 MA50(1803) 还在 1900 上方老远、RSI14 才 44.2 趴在弱势区，长线下跌结构远没翻，1954 的近 30 天高点就是头顶那道硬墙。

关键位划死：上方 1925.85 日内高 + 1953.79 近 30 天高点是第一道坎，今晚摸了 1925 就回、量也没跟上，过不去就是弱；真要突破得看一根实体阳线放量站上 1954 才算打开空间。下方 1911（4h MA25 / 日内低叠区）是刚站上的线，回踩不破才认短多有效；真跌破 1887（4h MA50）反弹结构就松，再往下 1803（日 MA50）是中线多头命门，破了才重新打开往 1776 前低去的空间。

💧 衍生品与链上
永续资金费率今晚仍贴地（约 0.00x%，8h），多头没上头，盘面干干净净没泡沫。未平仓这块实时精确值我这边拉不到（公开接口部分受限），不瞎编具体数字，但从「价横、费率近零、量不放大」的组合看，杠杆资金没在赌方向，这种冷清下的横盘最不容易出踩踏，也最磨人。链上 Gas、质押率、ETF 净流入的实时精确值同样拉不到，不编数字。能确认的是衍生品层面没异常信号——没有大规模爆仓或资金外逃的迹象。ETH/BTC 今晚趴在 0.0295 一带，相对强度没明显走弱也没抢跑，跟大饼同步震荡。

📰 消息面
实时新闻抓取通道当前不可用（web_search 被禁用），抓不到直接砸/拉 ETH 的单一硬催化，不编具体事件。能确认的是技术面今晚是纯缩量横盘，没有消息驱动。宏观上近期美联储按兵不动后市场还在数据博弈期，风险情绪偏冷，ETH 这种没有独立催化时只会跟着大饼脸色走，今晚这波就是技术面消耗而非消息驱动。

👉 我的看法
短线我把 ETH 读成「缩量窄幅磨、1h 平衡、4h 转多雏形、日线仍弱」。今晚实质进展几乎没有——就是 1900 上方又磨了一晚，4h 站上了中期均线带算比前两天硬一点，但日线 RSI 才 44、1954 压着，长线空头结构没动。操作上，没仓的别在 1917 这根盲动，等两件事之一：要么 1954 有效突破且回踩不破、最好放量，我才认短多延续；要么回调到 1911-1887 叠区企稳再上车，胜率比现在动高。有仓的把止损挂在 1887（4h MA50）下方，别跟零费率谈信仰。中线只要日线稳站 1954 且 RSI 回到 50 上方，我才认短空结构松动；下方 1803 不破就还是区间。仓位控小，这种量能下插针最容易扫单。

translatedData.content:
Check a project on-chain in 3 steps—you can help you avoid 90% of pitfalls.
Many people lose money not because they’re unlucky, but because they didn’t even check who the project team is before jumping in.

Before I buy any coin, I must pass these three checks:

1. Check the distribution of coin-holding addresses: if the top 10 addresses account for more than 60%, it means the supply is mostly in the hands of the insiders. If you enter, you’re just helping them “carry the sedan.”
2. Check contract permissions: for projects on ETH, go straight to Etherscan to view the contract source code. Focus on whether it has renounce (i.e., relinquished permissions)—if the contract still has permissions, the insiders can crush you anytime.
3. Check the project team’s transfer records: whether large token amounts have been moved to exchanges—moving coins is basically preparing to ship out. This action is more honest than any so-called “good news.”

One more thing I’d add: when the price is rising but the number of holders is decreasing, it’s usually wash-trading used to fool new buyers. I just block those.

My rule: if these three steps aren’t completed, I won’t touch a single cent—even if the narrative sounds super hot. Unless I can personally verify the on-chain data, in my view it might as well not exist. Better miss out than be the bag-holder—on-chain data won’t lie; only people who don’t check get tricked.

Before you buy a coin, do you check on-chain data? Or do you just look at the K-line and go in? Share your habits in the comments.

content:
链上查项目就 3 步，能帮你躲开 90% 的坑。
很多人亏钱不是运气差，是连项目方是谁都没查过就冲了。

我买任何币之前，必过这三关：

1. 查持币地址分布：前 10 名地址占比超过 60%，说明筹码全在庄家手里，你进去就是给他抬轿。
2. 查合约权限：ETH 上的项目直接上 Etherscan 看合约源码，重点看有没有 renounce（放弃权限）——权限没丢的合约，庄家想砸你随时砸。
3. 查项目方转账记录：大额代币有没有往交易所搬——搬币等于准备出货，这个动作比任何利好都诚实。

再加一条我的补充：价格在涨、持有人数却在减少，多半是对倒骗接盘，这种我直接拉黑。

我的规矩：这三步没走完，再火的叙事我也不碰一分钱；除非我能亲自把链上数据验证完，否则它在我这里等于不存在。宁可错过，不能接盘——链上数据不会骗人，只有你不查才会被骗。

【A Signal the Market Has Forgotten: The More Everyone Fears, the Less ETH Falls】

Let me tell you something interesting.

Right now the FNG index is 31, and the market is in fear. But when you look at ETH’s performance over this period—over the past 7 days it’s up nearly 3%. The price has stayed calmly hovering in the 1873 to 1962 range. It simply hasn’t crashed with the sentiment.

That’s the key point I want to make.

From the daily chart, ETH’s highs have been consistently trending down (from 2000 at the start of the month to 1962 now). The lows are also converging—this is a classic late-stage converging triangle. The 4-hour chart makes it clearer: price repeatedly tests support above 1873, yet volume keeps getting lower; every dip comes with reduced volume. The 1-hour structure is similar too—big players are not really selling into the market.

So what does this structure mean?

Both bulls and bears are waiting. The bears are waiting for a failure to break 1962 before they push the sell-off. The bulls are waiting for 1873 to hold and then break upward. But the only real thing that can break this balance won’t be retail sentiment—it will be an external catalyst.

The EIP-8363 news is an example. The controversy over staking changes may affect market sentiment in the short term. But from a business-logic perspective, institutions look at compliance and the stability of returns—not the fine details of that proposal. So when this kind of news hits, it usually only causes intraday fluctuations and does not change the mid-term structure.

So who will be truly affected?

Institutional investors care most whether 1962 can break; they’re waiting for a trend-confirmation signal before adding to positions. DeFi protocols are watching 1873—once that level breaks, liquidation risk is likely to rise. Market makers are currently the most comfortable: range-bound volatility lets them trade swings well, but if there’s a breakout with volume, they’ll be the fastest to move the other way.

What’s most likely next?

I lean toward a higher probability of an upward move. The reason is simple: an FNG value of 31 is a relatively low “fear” level. Historically, when FNG levels off at low positions and price doesn’t print new lows afterward, a rebound correction often follows. The 7-day +3% move isn’t huge, but it suggests that someone has been quietly absorbing.

However, there’s a condition: you must see a breakout above 1962 with volume—otherwise it’s just a false breakout.

What if it breaks down through 1873 with volume? Then the converging structure is invalidated, and my view would need to be revised.

So my final practical question for you is: in your view, is this current range-bound action institutions accumulating, or a bull trap? Either way, I’ve already been building my position gradually—not going all-in, but averaging in.

content:
【一个被市场遗忘的信号：大家越害怕，ETH反而越不跌了】

说个有意思的事。

现在FNG指数31，市场一片恐惧。但你回头看这段时间ETH的表现——7天小涨了将近3%，价格稳稳地贴着1873到1962这个区间晃悠，根本没有跟着情绪往下砸。

这就是我要说的重点。

从日线看，ETH的高点一直在下移（从月初的2000到现在的1962），低点也在收敛——典型的收敛三角形末期。4小时图更清楚，价格在1873上方反复测试支撑，成交量却越来越低，每次下探都缩量。1小时结构也是，大户根本没在出货。

这种结构意味着什么？

多空都在等。空头等着1962破不了再砸，多头等着1873撑住后往上突。但真正能打破这个平衡的，不会是散户情绪，只会是外部催化剂。

EIP-8363的消息是个例子——staking改动的争议短期会影响市场情绪，但落到商业逻辑上，机构进场看的是合规和收益稳定性，不是这个方案细节。所以这种消息冲击，通常只会造成日内波动，不会改变中期结构。

那谁会真正受影响？

机构投资者最在意1962能不能破，他们等的是趋势确认信号才愿意加仓；DeFi协议盯着1873，这位置破了意味着清算风险要起来；做市商现在最舒服，区间震荡正好做波段，但一旦放量突破，他们是最快反向的。

接下来最可能怎么走？

我倾向于认为向上的概率更大。理由很简单：恐惧指数31是偏低的位置，历史上一旦FNG在低位走平而价格没有新低，后面往往有个反弹修复。7天涨3%这个幅度虽然不大，但说明有人在悄悄承接。

但有个前提——必须放量突破1962，不然就是假突破。

如果放量跌穿1873呢？那收敛结构就被破坏了，我的判断就得修正。

所以最后问你一个实操问题：你觉得现在这种区间震荡，是机构在吸筹，还是多头陷阱？反正我自己的仓位已经在慢慢布局了，但不是梭哈那种，是分批建。

Russian forces launch large-scale airstrikes on Odesa! Panic-hedging sentiment rises—BTC at $64,976 could be in trouble

💡 Bearish warning: Geo-conflict escalation → global risk-asset sell-off pressure → BTC and ETH face near-term headwinds

In plain terms: This isn’t just a normal clash for Russia—this time they’re directly threatening the global grain supply chain. Once food security is impacted, the international market’s first reaction is to dump risk assets, and the crypto market is hit first. The transmission path is very clear: geo-conflict escalation → a surge in global risk-off sentiment → institutions pull out high-risk capital first → BTC takes the direct selling pressure.

One sentence to sum it up:
Russia’s airstrike escalation on Odesa spreads a widening geopolitical crisis, risk-off sentiment goes global, and the crypto market faces near-term pressure.

What happened?
Russian forces launched large-scale attacks on the southern Ukrainian port city of Odesa, directly threatening the Black Sea grain export route. Why does this matter? Because Odesa is a key node for global agricultural product shipping—once the supply chain is disrupted, soaring food prices will push up global inflation expectations, making central banks even less willing to cut rates. For crypto, rising geopolitical risk = rising hedging sentiment = risk assets get sold off. BTC may be called “digital gold,” but when real panic hits, institutions run faster than anyone.

Market impact
In the short term, panic will likely hit first. BTC at $64,976 was already struggling to hold ground; over the past 24 hours it’s down 0.07%. ETH is weaker too—$1,920.71 is down only 0.04%, but trading volume has shrunk. In this situation, traditional finance and crypto will move more in sync; if the Nasdaq sells off again tonight, BTC will most likely test lower levels.

In the medium term: if the conflict keeps escalating, capital will continue flowing from risk assets into U.S. Treasuries and gold. The crypto rebound window may be delayed.

My take
I’m bearish—don’t rush to catch a falling knife in the short term. Key support for BTC is around $62,000. If U.S. stocks keep selling off after tonight’s open, this level likely won’t hold. For ETH, it’s even worse—once $1,900 breaks, it may head toward $1,800. This isn’t the time to bottom-fish. Wait until the panic index drops into an extreme fear zone, or when geopolitical signs of easing appear.

BIP-110 Bitcoin hard fork stuck! Severe lack of hash power—BTC $64,977 on the line

BIP-110 forces the fork to get stuck after two blocks. Miners simply don’t buy into it, which is a negative factor for expectations of a Bitcoin network upgrade.

This Bitcoin fork proposal, BIP-110, originally intended to force an upgrade. But under the complete network mining difficulty, it only ran for two blocks before it completely jammed. Plainly speaking, the forced signaling mechanism does work—but almost no miners are willing to put their hash power in to support it. What does that mean? The miner community simply isn’t interested in this upgrade. Without enough hash power backing it, a fork is like a car with no fuel—awkwardly parked in the middle of the road.

Market impact
- Short term: Expectations for Bitcoin’s technical upgrade are directly slapped in the face. If hash power won’t support it, consensus won’t be reached—this kind of “half-baked” fork is most likely to shake retail confidence. BTC is down slightly today by 0.04% to $64,977.22. Near-term sentiment is bearish, and it may trigger panic selling and trimming positions by retail traders.
- Medium term: If hash power still can’t catch up afterward, BIP-110 is basically declared dead. The market will refocus on Bitcoin’s core narrative, but in the short term, the shadow of a fork failure will suppress bull momentum.

My take
Bearish—no hiding it. BTC at $64,977.22 is already a delicate spot. A 0.04% drop over 24 hours doesn’t look like much, but the news of the BIP-110 fork failure will accelerate pressure from the bears. Within 12 hours, it’s likely to test the $64,000 support. ETH hasn’t fallen in step—$1,920.64 could be breached at any time. If you don’t have a position, don’t rush to buy the dip; wait for a stabilization signal.

Netanyahu Makes a Hard Stand: No Palestinian State! Geopolitical Tensions Continue as BTC Fluctuates Around $64,977

Israel’s Prime Minister clearly rejects the establishment of a Palestinian state, dealing another blow to the Middle East peace process and keeping safe-haven sentiment intact.

Netanyahu has stated publicly that as long as he remains in office, there will be no Palestinian state in Gaza and the West Bank. In plain terms, this is essentially directly negating the “two-state solution” pushed by the international community. Friends, think about it—once this stance is on the table, the geopolitical game in the Middle East simply can’t stop in the near term. Regional stability will remain under pressure, and things won’t look good short-term.

Market Impact
Geopolitical conflict isn’t going to end anytime soon, but honestly, how it transmits to the crypto market needs careful consideration. It won’t trigger an instant, panic-driven crash like a sudden war might; instead, it’s a slow variable that keeps building. The transmission path looks like this: ongoing tensions → global traditional risk appetite declines → safe-haven funds are reallocated. However, crypto assets are currently in an awkward position: foreign capital treats them as high-risk tech stocks for positioning, not as a true digital gold hedge. So when geopolitical tension causes traditional capital to pull away, it can directly increase selling pressure on BTC and cap upside momentum.

- Short term: Panic sentiment is mild. BTC chops around the $64,977.22 area, grinding lower—but it likely won’t plunge sharply, and it also lacks the direct catalyst to rally.
- Medium term: International diplomatic efforts are blocked. Market risk appetite stays under pressure. Large off-exchange funds are likely to keep watching from the sidelines, with inflows slowing.

For those already holding positions, the focus is to manage based on whether support has failed, not to be carried around by every fluctuation. For those on the sidelines, prioritize waiting for a breakout with a pullback, or for confirmation of support. If I had just one month to become a better trader, I’d focus on: Market Structure

Not a new indicator.
Not a new strategy every day.
This skill is called Market Structure.

Simply put: Market structure tells you whether the trend is bullish, bearish, or ranging, and it shows you when the movement started to change.

Practical exercise: mark the last two highs and the last two lows. If the highs and lows are getting higher, the trend is bullish. If they’re getting lower, the trend is bearish.

Pay attention: don’t consider a single candle a market structure change. Wait for a clear break and a logical close.

This time’s follow-up angle: read the price action calmly before making any decision.

If you understand this point, your market reading will be calmer and your decisions will be clearer.
Keep up to be the first to get every new update. Educational content, not financial advice.

Coldcard Firmware Vulnerability Exposed! Can BTC $65,185 hold up?

💡 Bearish 📉 Bitcoin’s hardware wallet leader is in trouble, shaking trust in self-custody security.

Coldcard, a long-established wallet manufacturer, has been reported to have a serious firmware vulnerability that directly affects the mnemonic generation mechanism—meaning the underlying entropy may be flawed.

In one sentence
A security flaw in Coldcard firmware directly impacts the randomness of mnemonic generation for BTC wallets.

What happened
To put it plainly, this is a pretty severe issue. As a widely recognized reliable hardware wallet in the industry, Coldcard’s firmware flaw lies in the entropy used during seed generation. If you usually store a large amount of BTC on your Coldcard, and you happen to use an affected firmware version, your private key randomness could be significantly weakened. In theory, someone might be able to reverse-engineer your mnemonic from the vulnerability, then drain the BTC in your cold wallet. I kept staring at the chart on Sunday evening until 10 o’clock.
My neck was stiff, like it had rusted.
My eyes went dry and unfocused.

Today BTC moved from 64,730 to 65,266.
It closed at 65,227—just 39 points shy of the day’s high.
It moved more than 500 points all day, yet it was unusually calm and orderly.
Trading volume was 375 million—small for a Sunday.
A volume-shrinking rally to the high is the most annoying combo.

If I were the market maker, I’d have a big pile of coins in hand.
Dumping now wouldn’t help—there’s so little volume that you can’t get rid of all the inventory.
Either push it to the upper Bollinger Band near 65,600 and distribute with volume.
Or slam it back to 64,900, wash out a batch of people, then pull it up again.
64,900 is where MA5 and MA20 are tangled.
MA5 is at 64,880, MA20 at 64,750—very close together.
Below, there’s a stack of the coins bought today; if it can hold, it holds.

At 65,227, the price is above both moving averages.
It’s hugging the upper Bollinger Band; RSI is 58—still far from overbought.
When price sticks to the upper band but volume shrinks, that’s what worries me most.
If it doesn’t produce volume tomorrow, this spot is likely to get hit.

ETH is just a follower.
From 1,912 to 1,926, it closed at 1,924—its range is under 1%.
Trading value was 134 million, not even half of TUT.

TUT surged 126.50% and closed at 0.152840.
A meme coin had trading value of 246 million—over a hundred million more than ETH.
You ask me why it rose—I honestly don’t know.
Chasing at a time like this is like reaching out to catch a flying knife.
How crazy the emotion can make it rise, is how ugly it can look when it drops.

Tomorrow I’ll do it like this myself.
If BTC retraces to 64,900–65,000 and doesn’t break, I’ll try a small long position.
If it falls through 64,700, then I’m wrong—I’ll admit it and exit.
If it rebounds to 65,600, I’ll cut half first.
Don’t chase if it gaps up and spikes quickly.
Don’t chase if it rises on even lower volume.
This playbook is at most my own trading habit, not investment advice.

The most worth watching tomorrow is the volume of the very first 1-hour candle at the open for BTC.
If it pushes through 65,600 with increased volume, you can still look for a bit higher in the short term.
If it continues to shrink in volume, then first see whether 64,900 can hold.

If volume doesn’t show up, I’ll go to bed with an empty position.
